data.title: Saudi Arabia Strongly Condemns Iranian Attacks on Civilian Industrial Facility in Bahrain
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia’s strongest condemnation of the Iranian attacks on a civilian industrial facility in the Kingdom of Bahrain and affirmed full solidarity with Bahrain regarding any measures it may take to protect its security and stability.
    In a statement, the ministry said Saudi Arabia reiterates its categorical rejection of Iran’s continued actions that undermine regional security and stability, targeting of regional states and civilian infrastructure, violations of international law, the UN Charter, and the Charter of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation, and disregard for the principles of good neighborliness. Saudi Arabia holds Iran responsible for the consequences of its continued acts of aggression.
    -- SPA
13:17 Local Time 10:17 GMT
